description: This file defines the SmsSender class in the cuttlefish namespace, which provides an interface for sending SMS messages via a modem simulator. It includes a constructor to initialize with a SharedFD and a method to send SMS messages. The header also manages external dependencies and licensing information.

classes.name: SmsSender
classes.description: A class responsible for sending SMS messages using a modem simulator, encapsulating the file descriptor and send logic.

methods.name: SmsSender
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SmsSender with a shared file descriptor for the modem simulator.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends an SMS message with the specified body and sender number; returns true if successful.
